reference_lines.text: [F4] A compact smooth Riemannian manifold has a finite strongly geodesically convex cover whose finite nerve realization is homotopy equivalent to it. [[lem-qftx-compact-smooth-manifold-has-finite-good-cover-nerve-model]]

[F2] A compact smooth Riemannian manifold admits a finite strongly geodesically convex cover whose finite nerve is homotopy equivalent to it. [[lem-qftx-compact-smooth-manifold-has-finite-good-cover-nerve-model]]

[F4] The product Milnor bundle \(ET\to BT\) is numerable, and \(BT=(\mathbb{CP}^{\infty})^r\) has its ordinary countable CW topology. For closed \(H\subseteq T\), \(T/H\) is a compact smooth manifold; the local finite-nerve lemma gives it CW type. The quotient \(ET/H\cong ET\times_T(T/H)\to BT\) is a numerable locally trivial bundle with compact fiber \(T/H\). The compact-fiber bundle theorem therefore makes \(ET/H\) paracompact Hausdorff, CGWH, and of CW type. Also \(ET\to ET/H\) is a locally trivial principal \(H\)-bundle. Also \(BT\times F_0\) is paracompact Hausdorff of CW type. [[lem-qftx-compact-manifold-cohomology-positive-ideal-nilpotent]] [[lem-qftx-borel-base-is-paracompact-of-cw-type]]

[F4] The product Milnor bundle \(ET\to BT\) is numerable, and \(BT=(\mathbb{CP}^{\infty})^r\) has its ordinary countable CW topology. The compact-fiber bundle theorem therefore makes \(ET/H\) paracompact Hausdorff, CGWH, and of CW type. Also \(ET\to ET/H\) is a locally trivial principal \(H\)-bundle. The Thom theorem uses the closed disk/sphere pair specified by the metric-vector-bundle definition; an oriented numerable vector bundle over this base has a normalized Thom class and Thom isomorphism.
